evidence_candidates.source_locator: usage, recompilation, transfer-server, and manual sections
evidence_candidates.excerpt: Tohoku documents that AOBA-S requires recompilation of AOBA-A binaries, provides dedicated front-end and transfer servers, and supplies procedures for copying data from AOBA-A storage plus application manuals.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: AOBA-S documents both a compatibility boundary and concrete data and software migration support.
